cues.title: 观察铜表面
cues.caption: 黑色氧化层来自空气中的氧。
cues.captionEn: Air supplies oxygen for the black oxide.
cues.zh: 先看同一根铜丝。它在空气中受热，红色的铜表面逐渐出现黑色氧化铜。这里既需要加热，也需要空气提供氧。颜色变化对应铜的氧化，不是把灯焰的颜色涂到铜丝上。先记住这层黑色表面，下一镜继续追踪它。
cues.en: Follow one copper coil. Heating in air turns its reddish surface black as copper oxide forms. Air supplies oxygen while the flame supplies heat. The changing colour represents oxidation of the copper, not light reflected from the flame. Keep track of this same blackened surface as the coil moves to the next observation.

cues.title: 乙醇中恢复铜色
cues.caption: 铜色恢复，伴随乙醇被氧化。
cues.captionEn: Copper returns as ethanol is oxidized.
cues.zh: 把视线留在黑色表面：热铜丝接触乙醇后，黑色逐渐退去，铜色重新出现。模型把氧化铜被还原和乙醇被氧化连在一起。乙醇在这里生成乙醛和水，并非直接燃烧成二氧化碳。教材记载的气味属于辅助观察，画面不把颜色恢复当作单独确认乙醛的完整检验。
cues.en: The hot, blackened coil now contacts ethanol. The dark surface recedes and the copper colour returns. Reduction of copper oxide is coupled to oxidation of ethanol, producing acetaldehyde and water in this account. This differs from complete combustion to carbon dioxide. The textbook also records an odour observation, but the returning copper colour alone is not a complete identification of acetaldehyde.

cues.title: 铜循环，氧会用完吗？
cues.titleEn: Can a copper cycle run out of oxygen?
cues.caption: 铜能再生，氧的库存会耗尽。
cues.captionEn: Copper regenerates; oxygen can run out.
cues.zh: 同一份铜再完成两次循环，乙醛累计增加，铜元素总量不变。把空气中的氧化和乙醇中的还原两步叠在一起，约去两边的铜和氧化铜：净反应仍要消耗乙醇和氧气。催化剂会再生，不等于原料不用消耗。现在先让一份铜全部变成氧化铜，再切断空气。接触过量乙醇，还能生成乙醛吗？先预测。模型中仍能生成一份，因为氧化层已经储存了氧；铜色恢复后，再重复接触也不会继续增加。这个限制针对画出的铜和氧化铜供氧路径，不是否定其他条件下的醇脱氢反应。
cues.en: The same copper completes two more cycles. Acetaldehyde accumulates while the total copper stays fixed. Add oxidation in air to reduction by ethanol, then cancel copper and copper oxide from both sides. Ethanol and oxygen are still consumed: regenerating a catalyst does not regenerate the reactants. Now begin with one full unit of copper oxide and cut off fresh air. Can excess ethanol still produce acetaldehyde? Predict first. One unit can still form because the oxide already stores oxygen. Once copper returns, repeating the contact adds no more product in this model. That limit belongs to this copper–oxide oxygen route; it does not rule out alcohol dehydrogenation under other conditions.

cues.title: 两个氢与两份电子去哪了？
cues.titleEn: Where do two hydrogens and two electrons go?
cues.caption: 同一净反应，同时核对原子与电子。
cues.captionEn: Balance atoms and electrons in the same net reaction.
cues.zh: 先用形式氧化数记账。连着羟基的碳从负一价升到正一价，乙醇给出两份电子当量；铜从正二价降到零价，正好接受两份。这不是拍到电子飞行，也不是一步反应机理。再跟住原子：乙醇的氧留在原来的碳旁，形成羰基。羟基的一个氢和相邻碳的一个氢离开，与氧化铜的氧计入水。其余碳氢骨架保留。同一份净反应，既要对得上原子，也要对得上氧化还原的电子份额。
cues.en: Begin with formal oxidation numbers. The carbon bearing the hydroxyl group rises from minus one to plus one: ethanol supplies two electron equivalents. Copper falls from plus two to zero and accepts two. This is bookkeeping, not a filmed electron trajectory or a single reaction step. Now follow the atoms. Ethanol’s oxygen stays beside the same carbon as a carbonyl forms. One hydroxyl hydrogen and one hydrogen on that carbon are accounted for in water with oxygen from copper oxide. The remaining carbon–hydrogen framework stays intact. The same net reaction must balance atoms as well as electron equivalents.

cues.title: 观察酸性氧化剂
cues.caption: 颜色指向铬的还原，不独自证明产物。
cues.captionEn: Colour points to chromium reduction, not product identity.
cues.zh: 换到教材的另一种氧化条件：酸性重铬酸钾溶液与乙醇接触后，橙色转向绿色。下方把铬原子分成六价与三价两栏，总量不变。色彩只表示两种状态的定性变化，不是吸光度读数。自由探索里改变乙醇或氧化剂的份数，反应物不足时，过量的氧化剂可以留下来。
cues.en: Now use the textbook’s other oxidation condition: acidified dichromate with ethanol. Orange shifts towards green as chromium six is reduced to chromium three. The two counts retain the same total number of chromium atoms. Colour is a qualitative illustration, not an absorbance reading. In exploration, changing the alcohol or oxidant amount can leave excess oxidant when another reactant runs out.

cues.title: 多加乙醇，乙酸就加倍吗？
cues.titleEn: Does twice the ethanol make twice the acid?
cues.caption: 用电子配比，预测谁先用完。
cues.captionEn: Use electron ratios to predict the limiting reactant.
cues.zh: 教材把进一步氧化分成两段：乙醇失去两个氢成为乙醛，乙醛再加氧成为乙酸。跟住同一个碳，氧化数从负一到正一，再到正三；完全走到乙酸，共给出四份电子。一个重铬酸根含两个六价铬，降到三价共接受六份电子。三份乙醇与两份重铬酸根，正好配成十二份。现在乙醇从三份加到六份，氧化剂和酸保持原量，乙酸也会加倍吗？先预测。不会：这份模型仍最多生成三份乙酸，另外三份乙醇留下。实际混合物会受条件影响，颜色变化不能单独证明某一刻已经得到纯乙酸。
cues.en: The textbook separates further oxidation into two stages. Ethanol loses two hydrogens to become acetaldehyde; adding oxygen gives ethanoic acid. Follow the same carbon: minus one, plus one, then plus three. Reaching the acid releases four electron equivalents. Each dichromate contains two chromium-six atoms; becoming chromium three accepts six electrons altogether. Three ethanol units and two dichromate units match at twelve. Now double ethanol from three to six, keeping oxidant and acid unchanged. Will the acid product double? Predict first. No: this model still produces at most three acid units, leaving three ethanol units. Actual mixtures depend on conditions; colour alone cannot establish pure ethanoic acid at a particular instant.

question.zh: 铜能回来，氧为什么会用完？
question.en: Copper returns. Why can oxygen run out?

lead.zh: 从黑层与铜色往返，追到原子、电子和有限氧库存。
lead.en: Follow changing copper colour into atom, electron and finite-oxygen accounts.

principle.zh: 铜与氧化铜循环再生；净反应仍消耗乙醇和氧，乙醇到乙醛对应两份电子当量。
principle.en: Copper and its oxide regenerate in a cycle; the net reaction consumes ethanol and oxygen. Ethanol to ethanal transfers two electron equivalents.

question.zh: 先有1份CuO再切断空气，过量乙醇还能生成多少乙醛？
question.en: With one initial CuO unit and no fresh air, how much ethanal can excess ethanol form?

explanation.zh: 在这条Cu/CuO供氧路径的模型中最多1份。原有氧化层可供一次反应，随后要补氧才能继续。
explanation.en: At most one unit in this Cu/CuO oxygen-route model. The initial oxide supports one turn; continued cycling needs fresh oxygen.

question.zh: 乙醇加倍，乙酸就加倍吗？
question.en: Does twice the ethanol give twice the acid?

lead.zh: 把铬的颜色变化与有机碳的电子份额相连，再检验限量预测。
lead.en: Connect chromium colour to the organic carbon electron account, then test a limiting-reactant prediction.

principle.zh: 乙醇完全到乙酸给出4电子当量，重铬酸根接受6；3:2配比还须有足够酸。
principle.en: Full oxidation of ethanol to acid supplies four electron equivalents; dichromate accepts six. The 3:2 ratio also requires sufficient acid.

question.zh: 乙醇6份、重铬酸根2份、H⁺16份，完全到酸的模型终点是什么？
question.en: With 6 ethanol, 2 dichromate and 16 H⁺ units, what is the full-acid model endpoint?

explanation.zh: 3份乙酸与3份剩余乙醇。该净反应终点不是从颜色测得的瞬时组成。
explanation.en: Three acid units and three unreacted ethanol units. This net endpoint is not an instantaneous composition measured from colour.
